title: Sages of the Nations
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: They are mentioned in [Pesachim 94b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.94b.5) regarding the sun's course, where Rabbi said, “Their account seems more convincing than ours.” In [Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Bava_Batra.8.1.2) they say that a son and daughter are equal regarding inheritance; this is also related in [Shabbat 116b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.116b.1).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rabbi’s preference at Pesachim 94b concerns the nighttime course of the sun.
The Yerushalmi attributes equal inheritance of sons and daughters to the sages of the nations. In the Shabbat story a judge makes the claim during a staged dispute.
